headline: ABITIBI DRILL SEASON OPEN: First Mining Gold Launches 12,000m Duparquet Campaign with Indigenous-Led Partner Forage Anicinape
snippet: First Mining Gold (TSX-V: FF) launched its 2026 drill program at the 3.44M oz AuEq Duparquet deposit in Quebec's Abitibi — 12,000m across two rigs testing the Miroir zone and resource growth targets — and signed a milestone drilling partnership with Forage Anicinape, an Indigenous-led contractor owned by the Pikogan First Nation.

headline: BEST QUARTER IN 20 YEARS: IMPACT Silver Q1 Revenue Nearly Triples to $31.2M, Record $11.3M Net Income — Zero Debt
snippet: IPT.V's Zacualpan Silver Operation delivered its strongest quarter in two decades — revenue nearly tripling on higher silver prices, better grades, and increased throughput — with gross profit up tenfold to $20.3M, record net income of $11.3M, $45.3M cash, and zero long-term debt.

headline: XI-PUTIN: China and Russia Sign Three Nuclear Energy MOUs, Deepening Uranium Demand Signal for Athabasca Basin Producers
snippet: At Putin's May 21 Beijing summit, China and Russia signed three nuclear energy MOUs covering fast-neutron reactor cooperation, the closed nuclear fuel cycle, and completion of the Tianwan and Xudapu plants scheduled for 2026–27 commissioning — adding a structural demand signal to a uranium spot market holding above $84/lb.

headline: SEABED RUSH: 9 Companies Seek US Deep-Sea Mining Permits One Year After Trump's Executive Order — Stocks Soar
snippet: An AP investigation finds nine companies in active talks with US regulators for seabed mineral access, one year after Trump's executive order fast-tracking deep-sea mining. Investor money is flooding in, stock prices have soared, and federal permitting has been accelerated — while environmental groups warn of irreversible damage to the ocean floor.

headline: LITHIUM RALLY COOLS: Prices Pull Back 2.2% from Two-Year High as Mine Restarts Signal Supply Response
snippet: Chinese lithium carbonate slipped to CNY 178,000/tonne on May 22, retreating from a two-year-plus high of CNY 200,500 hit on May 13, as the Q1 price-doubling triggered a wave of mine restarts — including MinRes' Bald Hill in Western Australia after an 18-month suspension — signalling the market is generating its own supply correction.

headline: CHINA JUNE QUOTA WATCH: NdPr Rare Earths Stabilise at $99/kg After 21% April Correction — Western Producers Still Profitable
snippet: NdPr oxide pulled back sharply in April to $99.61/kg — a 21% monthly decline — following a 105% Q1 rally. The metal is still 88% above its January open and above the cost base of MP Materials and Lynas. China's mid-year MIIT mining quota release, typically in June, is now the single most-watched event for NdPr price direction in H2 2026.

headline: GOLDSEEK WEEKLY: Junior Miners 'Awaiting a Catalyst' — Bull Market Infrastructure Intact, Biggest Moves Still Ahead
snippet: GoldSeek's current weekly roundup sees gold consolidating above $4,400 and silver above $72 while junior miners coil for a directional move. The editorial argues the long-term bull infrastructure — central bank demand, fiscal deterioration, and production constraints — is fully intact, with the sector's biggest gains still in front of retail investors who are patient enough to hold through the pause.
